title: LINE broadcasts
description: Send your listings as recommended places through getproperty’s LINE to people who opted in and are looking for what you have.

product.title: Recommended-places messages

body.open: You can schedule campaigns now. You pay for the people actually reached, after sending.
body.off: getproperty is waiting for LINE Thailand to confirm the terms. Meanwhile you can draft campaigns and see the estimated reach; sending opens once the service is switched on.
body.unpriced: The price per recipient has not been published yet. You can draft campaigns and see the estimated reach; the price appears here once it is on sale.
body.off_unpriced: getproperty is waiting for LINE Thailand to confirm the terms, and no price has been published yet. Meanwhile you can draft campaigns and see the estimated reach.

product.maxListingsValue: {count, plural, one {Up to # listing} other {Up to # listings}}
product.capValue: {count, plural, one {At most # message a week} other {At most # messages a week}}
product.capHint: Across every campaign on the platform
product.billing: Billed after sending, for the people actually reached, as an invoice on your subscription page. Nothing is prepaid; cancelled or stopped campaigns cost nothing.

how.title: Who gets it, and what you see
how.consent: Only people who chose to receive recommendations from getproperty themselves — they can stop any time with one tap.
how.match: Matched only on what they typed — areas, budget, room type, move-in window and language. No sensitive data or rent history.
how.numbers: You see totals only, never names or LINE accounts. Interested people contact you through the listing.
how.ad: Every message is labelled "Ad" and has a stop button.

list.title: My campaigns
list.emptyHint: Pick published listings, describe who is looking for them, and see the estimated reach before you decide.

builder.title: New campaign
builder.description: Pick listings, describe who is looking, and see the estimated reach and cost. Save it as a draft first; you schedule it from the campaign page.
builder.name: Campaign name
builder.nameHint: Only you and your team see it, e.g. "Ari condos, early December"
builder.listingsHint: {max, plural, one {Up to # listing; it must be published and visible on the site} other {Up to # listings; they must be published and visible on the site}}
builder.noListingsHint: Campaigns can only send listings that are published and visible on the site. Publish a listing first, then come back.
builder.audienceHint: Every field is optional — a field left empty does not narrow the group. Matching uses only what recipients typed themselves.
builder.areasChosen: {count, plural, one {# area chosen} other {# areas chosen}}
builder.areasMore: {count, plural, one {Show # more area} other {Show # more areas}}
builder.budgetHint: Matches people whose budget range overlaps this one; at least one listing’s rent must also be within their own budget.
builder.languagesHint: Each person gets the message in their chosen language. None chosen = every language.
builder.maxHint: {minimum, plural, one {At least # person is needed to schedule. The number reached may be lower: everyone’s weekly limit and quiet hours are respected.} other {At least # people are needed to schedule. The number reached may be lower: everyone’s weekly limit and quiet hours are respected.}}
builder.maxInvalid: Type a number of people from 1 to 1,000,000
builder.cannotSave: Only people who manage this account’s subscription can create campaigns
builder.moveInInverted: The end must not be before the start

estimate.title: Estimated reach
estimate.pick: Pick at least 1 listing to see the estimated reach
estimate.peopleHint: People who opted in and fit right now; counted again when sending.
estimate.capped: {count, plural, other {More people fit; it is sent to at most # as you set.}}
estimate.withheld: {minimum, plural, one {Fewer than # person} other {Fewer than # people}}
estimate.withheldHint: To protect recipients’ privacy, the number is not shown below the minimum. Try a wider group, e.g. more areas or a wider budget.
estimate.costHint: Billed for the people actually reached after sending, so it may be less.
estimate.noCost: Not on sale yet, so there is no price

detail.notPublicHint: A listing is unpublished or hidden. The campaign cannot be scheduled until it is visible again — or create a new campaign without it.
detail.costBody: Reaching the estimated {count} people would cost at most {total} incl. VAT. You are billed for the people actually reached after sending.
detail.rejectedBody: Reason: {reason} · Messages not yet sent were cancelled and the campaign costs nothing.
detail.cancelledBody: Nothing was sent and nothing is billed.
detail.scheduledBody: Sending starts {date}, in batches within the platform’s send window, respecting everyone’s quiet hours and weekly limit. You can cancel until it starts.
detail.draftHint: This campaign is a draft. Schedule it when you are ready.

report.title: Results
report.privacy: Totals only — no personal data. Interested people contact you through the listing.
report.openedHint: LINE gives no read data for messages sent to a group
report.leadsHint: {days, plural, one {Recipients who enquired on these listings within # day} other {Recipients who enquired on these listings within # days}}
report.sending: Sending in batches — the numbers grow until it finishes
report.notBilledYet: Invoiced when sending finishes, for the people actually reached
report.nobody: Nobody fitting the group could be reached during the send window, so this campaign costs nothing.

schedule.title: Schedule {name}
schedule.body: Sends to about {count} people who opted in and fit, at {price} per recipient before VAT. This price is locked from now on; you are billed for the people actually reached after sending{total, select, none {} other { (at most {total} incl. VAT)}}.
schedule.bodyUnknown: Recipients are counted again when you schedule. The price per recipient is locked from now on; you are billed for the people actually reached after sending.
schedule.nowHint: Starts within minutes, outside each person’s quiet hours
schedule.waiting: Scheduling opens once the service is switched on and priced

cancel.title: Cancel {name}
cancel.body: The campaign will not be sent and costs nothing. To send again, create a new campaign.

sponsored_disabled.title: Not available yet
sponsored_disabled.body: getproperty is still waiting for LINE Thailand’s confirmation. The campaign stays a draft and can be scheduled once the service opens. Nothing is charged.

not_on_sale.title: Not on sale yet
not_on_sale.body: No price per recipient has been published. The campaign stays a draft and can be scheduled once it is priced.

below_minimum.title: Below the minimum
below_minimum.body: Fewer people fit than the minimum right now, or the maximum you set is below it. Create a new campaign with a wider group — more areas, a wider budget or any language.

listing_not_public.title: A listing is no longer on the site
listing_not_public.body: Only published, visible listings can be sent. Publish it again, or create a new campaign without it.

invalid_state.title: This campaign has changed
invalid_state.body: It may already be scheduled, cancelled or stopped. Reload the page to see where it stands.

fromListing.title: Send this listing on LINE
fromListing.body: As a recommended place to people who opted in and are looking for one like it — see the estimated reach before you decide.
